external_ref.locator: Printed pp. ii (copyright and licence notice); 22–27 (migration/mobility concepts, definitions, stocks and flows); 30–33 (labour-force status, employment, unemployment and underutilization); 34–38 (international labour migration and labour attachment); 43 (minimum data items); 57–58 (core labour-market indicators for international migrants); 63–66 (source-specific coverage and limitations).

content.preservation: Work-level CC BY 4.0 is stated on printed p. ii; attribution to ILO and indication of changes are required. Third-party components are excluded and require separate rights review. ILO name/emblem/logo restrictions apply; no logo or third-party assets are reproduced. The guide is not translated or adapted. Its evidence does not establish automatic comparability of labour productivity for migrant groups.
